svg.text: Remote node (field) on the left; the local node (base station) needs no wiring. Schematic, not to scale.
≥ 1 A out, with EN pin (HIGH = on)
5 V: 75 mA, 325 mA with IR LEDs lit
3.3 V TTL serial: no level shifter
GPIO41 (J3 pin 8) → EN: camera power on/off
charges the LiPo through the board
• Header pin numbers follow the V4-R8 datasheet (J2 and J3, pin 1 = GND); highlighted pins are used. ESP32-S3 pins are 3.3 V only.
• Camera cable colours are Adafruit's for the weatherproof 613: red +5 V, black GND, white TX (out of camera), green RX (into camera).
• Boost GND goes to board GND (J2 pin 1), not to the battery − lead: the board switches battery − through a protection MOSFET.
• The boost converter is fed from the battery only, so fit the LiPo even on the bench. Never power a board without its LoRa antenna.
